semantic.justification: Actual browser/Worker single-shot host timer implements SalTimer,using current callback dispatch,pending-event replacement,cancellation and explicit destruction. The old handle is released before callback entry so native reentrant restart survives. Unsigned64 arguments are converted at the boundary;delays above signed32 host capacity are capped for the native scheduler deadline recheck,avoiding JavaScript overflow-to-immediate. Upstream QtTimer is also single-shot;browser event scheduling replaces the native Sal plugin. Full native scheduler/OS input/threads are not represented by this platform adapter.
